## What is Claude Code?

[§ 1 · INTRODUCTION]{.kicker}

::: {.dek}
An agentic coding tool that turns plain-English research design into
running code, in your terminal or IDE.
:::

<hr class="post-rule"/>

Claude Code is developed by Anthropic and operates directly in your
terminal, IDE, desktop app, and browser. It builds features from
plain-English descriptions, drafts plans, writes the code, and verifies
that the result matches what you asked for.

::: {.callout-note title="Key capabilities"}
- Builds features from plain-English descriptions
- Drafts plans, writes code, ensures functionality
- Automates the tedious parts of an empirical pipeline
:::

## Research Workflow Support

::: {.dek}
Claude Code can carry the entire pipeline — from raw data
to publication-ready outputs.
:::

<hr class="post-rule"/>

::: {.callout-tip title="Complete data analysis pipeline"}
Cleaning, modelling, visualization, and reproducible documentation in
one continuous, auditable trail.
:::

1. **Data management.** Navigate codebases and datasets.
2. **Statistical analysis.** Run econometric models.
3. **Visualization.** Generate publication-quality figures and tables.
4. **Documentation.** Read and document code for replicability.

## Econometric Modeling

::: {.dek}
Specialized econometric techniques live one prompt away.
:::

<hr class="post-rule"/>

::: {.callout-warning title="Advanced statistical methods"}
As a coding tool, Claude Code can implement the modern econometric
techniques essential for current empirical work.
:::

Native support for **R** and **Python**. **Stata** and **MATLAB** via
specialized MCP servers. The tool follows your conventions, not the
other way around.

## Example: Difference-in-Differences

::: {.dek}
Describe the research design in English; Claude assembles the code.
:::

<hr class="post-rule"/>

```bash
$ claude "Run a difference-in-differences regression
on the treatment effect of minimum wage policy using
panel data from 2010-2020, controlling for state and
year fixed effects"
```

Claude Code will load and clean the dataset, construct the right
variables, run the regression with robust standard errors, and emit
both regression tables and visualizations [@anthropic_claude_code_2025].

## Why Adopt Claude Code

::: {.dek}
Five gains, one caveat.
:::

<hr class="post-rule"/>

- **Speed.** Accelerate the tasks that consume your time.
- **Transparency.** Every step documented and auditable.
- **Flexibility.** Diverse cleaning + econometric methods.
- **Integration.** Connects to institutional data sources.
- **Reproducibility.** Built-in version control and documentation.

::: {.callout-important title="Caveat"}
Claude Code is an assistant, not a substitute for your expertise. Always
review the code and results. Final responsibility for accuracy rests
with you.
:::
